{
  "items": [
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0084"],
      "quote": "The Council does not pay any cost that a bidder incurs in preparing its tender.",
      "statement": "The Council does not pay any cost that a bidder incurs in preparing its tender.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0085"],
      "quote": "The Council does not accept variant tenders, and it reads only the files described in this section.",
      "statement": "The Council does not accept variant tenders, and it reads only the files described in this section.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0086"],
      "quote": "After the tender deadline, the Council contacts bidders through the portal only, and a bidder's answers to its questions form part of the tender.",
      "statement": "After the tender deadline, the Council contacts bidders through the portal only, and a bidder's answers to its questions form part of the tender.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0088"],
      "quote": "The Council checks each tender against the conditions in this section before it scores any response.",
      "statement": "The Council checks each tender against the conditions in this section before it scores any response.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0089"],
      "quote": "Each condition is pass or fail, and a tender that fails any of them is not evaluated further.",
      "statement": "Each condition is pass or fail, and a tender that fails any of them is not evaluated further.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0090"],
      "quote": "The bidder must have had an average annual turnover of at least £4,000,000 over its last three financial years.",
      "statement": "The bidder must have had an average annual turnover of at least £4,000,000 over its last three financial years.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0091"],
      "quote": "The bidder must hold ISO/IEC 27001 certification that covers the data centers and the support teams that deliver the service.",
      "statement": "The bidder must hold ISO/IEC 27001 certification that covers the data centers and the support teams that deliver the service.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0092"],
      "quote": "The Council reads each bidder's turnover from its audited accounts for its last three financial years.",
      "statement": "The Council reads each bidder's turnover from its audited accounts for its last three financial years.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0093"],
      "quote": "The Council checks every certificate with the body that issued it.",
      "statement": "The Council checks every certificate with the body that issued it.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0094"],
      "quote": "The exclusion grounds in Annex E apply to each bidder and to each subcontractor that the bidder names.",
      "statement": "The exclusion grounds in Annex E apply to each bidder and to each subcontractor that the bidder names.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0095"],
      "quote": "The Council asks for evidence on the exclusion grounds from the preferred bidder only, before the contract is awarded.",
      "statement": "The Council asks for evidence on the exclusion grounds from the preferred bidder only, before the contract is awarded.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0096"],
      "quote": "A consortium is treated as one bidder, and the conditions in this section apply to the consortium as a whole.",
      "statement": "A consortium is treated as one bidder, and the conditions in this section apply to the consortium as a whole.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0097"],
      "quote": "The Council publishes the outcome of the eligibility check to each bidder with the result of the evaluation.",
      "statement": "The Council publishes the outcome of the eligibility check to each bidder with the result of the evaluation.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0098"],
      "quote": "The service covers the whole life of a case, from the first contact by a resident to the decision, the closure of the case and its archiving.",
      "statement": "The service covers the whole life of a case, from the first contact by a resident to the decision, the closure of the case and its archiving.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0099"],
      "quote": "It replaces the Pellworth licensing database and the spreadsheets of the complaints and environmental health teams.",
      "statement": "It replaces the Pellworth licensing database and the spreadsheets of the complaints and environmental health teams.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0100"],
      "quote": "It also takes over the handling of repair cases, while the Quillbeck system keeps the tenancy and property records until its own replacement.",
      "statement": "It also takes over the handling of repair cases, while the Quillbeck system keeps the tenancy and property records until its own replacement.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0101"],
      "quote": "The service shall handle every case type the Council uses, including repairs, licensing applications, complaints, environmental health requests, etc.",
      "statement": "The service shall handle every case type the Council uses, including repairs, licensing applications, complaints, environmental health requests, etc.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0102"],
      "quote": "The service meets the requirements listed in Annex B, which form part of this specification.",
      "statement": "The service meets the requirements listed in Annex B, which form part of this specification.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0103"],
      "quote": "The Council expects about 85,000 new cases a year, with about 3,500 cases open at any time.",
      "statement": "The Council expects about 85,000 new cases a year, with about 3,500 cases open at any time.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0104"],
      "quote": "Staff work at the Civic Center, at Tanner's Yard and from home, and about 60 inspectors visit properties and premises each day.",
      "statement": "Staff work at the Civic Center, at Tanner's Yard and from home, and about 60 inspectors visit properties and premises each day.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0105"],
      "quote": "Inspectors often work in basements, plant rooms and rural areas of the borough where mobile coverage is poor.",
      "statement": "Inspectors often work in basements, plant rooms and rural areas of the borough where mobile coverage is poor.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0106"],
      "quote": "The service shall give field inspectors a mobile application that works without a network connection and stores each photograph with its GPS location.",
      "statement": "The service shall give field inspectors a mobile application that works without a network connection and stores each photograph with its GPS location.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0107"],
      "quote": "Bidders may offer a chat assistant on the resident portal as an optional extra, priced separately in Annex C.",
      "statement": "Bidders may offer a chat assistant on the resident portal as an optional extra, priced separately in Annex C.",
      "modality": "may",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0108"],
      "quote": "Sections 6 to 12 describe the requirements in more detail, grouped by topic, and Annex B adds the requirements that the teams raised during the market engagement.",
      "statement": "Sections 6 to 12 describe the requirements in more detail, grouped by topic, and Annex B adds the requirements that the teams raised during the market engagement.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0109"],
      "quote": "Each requirement applies for the whole contract term unless it states otherwise.",
      "statement": "Each requirement applies for the whole contract term unless it states otherwise.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0110"],
      "quote": "The Council held a market engagement day on 2026-09-09, and the questions raised there shaped this specification.",
      "statement": "The Council held a market engagement day on 2026-09-09, and the questions raised there shaped this specification.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0111"],
      "quote": "This section sets out what the service does for staff and residents.",
      "statement": "This section sets out what the service does for staff and residents.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0112"],
      "quote": "Section 6.1 covers case handling, section 6.2 the resident portal and section 6.3 documents and reporting.",
      "statement": "Section 6.1 covers case handling, section 6.2 the resident portal and section 6.3 documents and reporting.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0113"],
      "quote": "Today each team works in its own system, so the same resident can have four records that do not refer to one another.",
      "statement": "Today each team works in its own system, so the same resident can have four records that do not refer to one another.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0114"],
      "quote": "The service shall let authorized staff configure case types, stages, forms and service levels without any change to the software code.",
      "statement": "The service shall let authorized staff configure case types, stages, forms and service levels without any change to the software code.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0115"],
      "quote": "The service shall send the resident an acknowledgment with a case reference within one working day of a case being opened.",
      "statement": "The service shall send the resident an acknowledgment with a case reference within one working day of a case being opened.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0116"],
      "quote": "The service shall provide appropriate response times for every case type, so that residents know when to expect an answer.",
      "statement": "The service shall provide appropriate response times for every case type, so that residents know when to expect an answer.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0117"],
      "quote": "Officers today see their cases in separate lists in each system, and no list shows the cases that are close to their deadline.",
      "statement": "Officers today see their cases in separate lists in each system, and no list shows the cases that are close to their deadline.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0118"],
      "quote": "Team leaders move cases between officers by hand when an officer is absent.",
      "statement": "Team leaders move cases between officers by hand when an officer is absent.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0119"],
      "quote": "Each team has its own service levels, set by the cabinet each April.",
      "statement": "Each team has its own service levels, set by the cabinet each April.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0120"],
      "quote": "Repair requests follow a fixed path: a resident reports the fault, an officer orders the repair from a contractor in the Quillbeck system, and the resident confirms that the repair is done.",
      "statement": "Repair requests follow a fixed path: a resident reports the fault, an officer orders the repair from a contractor in the Quillbeck system, and the resident confirms that the repair is done.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    }
  ],
